problem:
The matrix form of the affine transformation $T$ is given by

$$
[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ 5 & 9\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 4\end{aligned}].
$$

Find $a+b+c,$ given that the matrix form of the inverse transformation ${T}^{-1}$ is given by

$$
[\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}a & 2 \\ b & -1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}10 \\ c\end{aligned}].
$$
